# Bioconductor-Physalia Courses

![](/images/collaborations/Physalia-Logo-1000x358.png){width=35% fig-alt="Physalia Courses logo"}

Bioconductor has partnered with [Physalia Courses](https://www.physalia-courses.org/) to offer co-branded training in bioinformatics and computational biology. These courses are taught by experienced instructors from the Bioconductor community and hosted by Physalia. Only courses displaying the Bioconductor-Physalia label are part of this collaboration.\[TODO: update with how the courses are defined]\

More details and registration links are available via Physalia’s [course listings](https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/).

## Free Seats for Underrepresented Countries

Two free seats are available for each Bioconductor–Physalia course for participants based in low- or middle-income countries, as defined by the [World Bank's income classification](https://datatopics.worldbank.org/world-development-indicators/the-world-by-income-and-region.html).

[Apply here to be considered](https://forms.gle/w4UEBu3VrJXemtTN9)
